mechanism: Indomethacin, a non-selective NSAID, antagonizes the prostaglandin-mediated effects of latanoprost by inhibiting cyclooxygenase and reducing prostaglandin synthesis, thereby reducing latanoprost's intraocular pressure-lowering efficacy.
action: Monitor intraocular pressure closely; consider alternative analgesics/anti-inflammatory agents if possible, or adjust latanoprost dosing; counsel patient on potential reduced glaucoma control.
